title: Embedded Safety-Aligned Intelligence via Differentiable Internal Alignment Embeddings
reasoning: The paper is a theoretical work in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) focusing on the mathematical formulation of 'internal alignment embeddings'. While it addresses topics like safety alignment and harm reduction, it treats these as mathematical signals and objectives within a control framework rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical systems as subjects of inquiry.
